about.title: About
about.p1: I am a third year Computer Science student at Collège de Bois-de-Boulogne with two years of hands on building behind me. Most of that time went into backend work: REST APIs, authentication, database design, and lately cloud infrastructure and AI automation.
about.p2: What I care about is the part nobody sees. Clean architecture that survives the second feature request. Security that is designed in rather than patched on. Code that a teammate can read six months later and change without fear. I would rather ship something small that holds than something large that leaks.
about.p3: Away from the editor I train in wrestling, judo and weightlifting, follow markets closely, and spend my summers running activities for seniors at a community centre in Montréal.
